215.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Pales"] == false

219.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
219.text: "Now you seem to be stuck in the mire, with no end in sight."

220.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
220.text: "And I have been following your progress in Total Tranquility with bated breath."
220.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Manpower_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Military_Stockpile_Low"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Pales"] == false) == false

221.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
221.text: "And our poor Vina is still behind enemy lines, if she is alive at all..."
221.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Heavy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Weak"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation2_TotalEnemy_Dead"] < 10) == false)

225.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
225.text: "The Alliance of Nations has turned against you..."

229.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
229.text: "Your soldiers don't seem to know which end of their guns to point at the enemy."

233.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
233.text: "Despite the low number of kills you've racked up, you do seem to be holding your own."

234.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
234.text: "You are racking up a respectable number of kills."

235.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
235.text: "Correct me if I'm wrong, my dear, but it seems Rizia is rather fucked."
235.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Heavy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Weak"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Operation2_TotalEnemy_Dead"] < 10) == false)

236.speaker: Narrator
236.text: Our server returned with a silver tray of piping hot scones and a crystal ramekin of rose-hip jam.

237.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
237.text: Spread the jam on your scone with the outer spoon.

238.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
238.text: Spread the jam on your scone with the middle spoon.

239.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
239.text: Spread the jam on your scone with the inner spoon.

240.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
240.text: "Look at you. You don't even know the right way to put jam on a bloody scone."

241.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
241.text: "You remembered your tea etiquette. All is not completely lost."

246.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
246.text: "I'll admit I thought our Vina would be returned home by this point in the conflict."
246.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Heavy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Weak"] == true) == false)

250.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
250.text: "Of course, I wasn't expecting the Alliance of Nations to turn against you..."

251.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
251.text: "Overall, the outcome is far from decided. But I do trust your kingdom to rip the Palesians a new arsehole."
251.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Heavy"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_ANSanctions_Weak"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Objective_Captured_Pales"] == true) == false)

255.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
255.text: "Then again, perhaps my trust was misplaced. You don't even know the right way to put jam on a bloody scone."

256.speaker: Player_Romus
256.text: "Your faith in me is heartening, dear sister-in-law. I promise I will win this for Rizia and Rumburg."

260.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
260.text: "The fact that you remembered your tea etiquette bolsters my confidence even further."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "I don't want to beg. But is there anything you can do for us?"

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "Please, Beatrice. Can't Rumburg help a fellow monarchy out?"

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "The situation is nowhere near as bad as you describe. I have everything under control."

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "It might look like we're doing well, but our troops are suffering out there. Is there anything you can do to help us?"

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "I know we're going to win. But a little extra insurance from Rumburg wouldn't hurt us."

267.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
267.text: "I'm afraid another military aid package is out of the question."

268.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
268.text: "We're going to need everything we've got for what's coming."
268.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Ending_WorldWar"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.PipelineNatDes_PipelineRepairRumburg"] == true) == false)

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "Let me guess. You're planning something against Sordland."

278.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
278.text: "If we were, would you run and tell your new Sordish friends all about it?"

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "I don't like the sound of that."

281.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
281.text: "Don't fret. It's nothing I would ask your kingdom to involve itself in."

282.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
282.text: "All is peaceful in Rumburg so far. But with neighbors like ours, we must be prepared for the worst."

283.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
283.text: "What I can offer you, Your Majesty, is a chance for peace."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "I don't want peace. I want the Gulf of Ales to run red with blood."

285.speaker: Player_Romus
285.text: "I like the sound of that. Tell me more."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "I have only ever wanted peace. It is the Palesians who are the warmongerers."

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "There will be no peace until Pales is ours."

291.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
291.text: "Pales is a speck of dust compared to Rumburg."

292.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
292.text: "Say the word, and my kingdom will step in and broker a ceasefire."

293.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
293.text: "The casualties among Rizians and Palesians will only mount unless a third party intervenes. Rumburg can be that third party."

296.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
296.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false

297.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
297.text: "It will be red with your blood if the war continues."

301.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
301.text: "It will be red with Vina's blood if the war continues."
301.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true)

302.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
302.text: "Then run red it shall. But you don't need our help for that."
302.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false)

305.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
305.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false

306.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
306.text: "Thousands of Rizians will die before that happens."

310.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
310.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true)

311.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
311.text: "Then by all means, fight on. You don't need our help for that."
311.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false)

312.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
312.text: "I confess I myself lack the patience for mediating. But my foreign affairs department is very skilled at defusing conflicts."

313.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
313.text: "Think about it. We could end this in a matter of days, without another drop of blood shed."

314.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
314.text: "And without risking further damage to the Aureus gas field, of course."

318.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
318.text: "More importantly... we could finally bring Vina home."

319.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
319.text: "I'm sure you do. But I kindly request that you hear me out anyway."

320.speaker: Player_Romus
320.text: "I appreciate the offer. But Rizia is perfectly capable of winning this war. Just give us time."

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: "Rumburg has too many conflicts of interest. You're far from a neutral third party."

322.speaker: Player_Romus
322.text: "I accept your offer, Queen Beatrice. It's time to end the Pales war."

323.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
323.text: "Nobody is neutral in this day and age. Not even Kyrute."

326.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
326.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false

328.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
328.text: "Very well. You are on your own, then."

329.speaker: Narrator

330.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
330.text: Eat a petit four with the outer spoon.

331.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
331.text: Eat a petit four with the middle spoon.

332.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic

333.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == false  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Weak"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_PowerProjection_Average"] == true) == false

335.speaker: Player_Romus
335.text: "And what would be in it for you, pray tell?"

339.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
339.text: "Aside from the assurance that my darling niece will live to see another day?"

340.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
340.text: "The war is having a deleterious effect on Rizia's capabilities as a trade partner and GRACE member."

344.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
344.text: "There are greater conflicts looming than your territorial spat. I want Rizia by our side for them."

345.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
345.text: "I would hate for your territorial spat to detract from your usefulness to us."

346.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
346.text: "As you wish, King Romus. I will make the arrangements at once."

347.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
347.text: "To do this any other way would be costly beyond belief. Trust me."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "My answer is no. Rizia will see this war through to the end."

349.speaker: Player_Romus
349.text: "If you truly think Rumburg can bring a bloodless end to this conflict, then I accept your offer."

350.speaker: Narrator
350.text: She paused as our server used a fine-bristled brush to sweep the scone crumbs off our table.

359.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
359.text: "Let's hope you're better at waging war than you are at conducting yourself at tea."

363.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
363.text: "Your tea conduct is atrocious, my dear. It's a good thing you have such civilized allies."

364.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
364.text: "Oh, dear. You were so close to getting it right."

368.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
368.text: "It's a good thing you have such civilized allies."

369.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
369.text: "Well done. The fate of the world is determined by the civilized, after all."

370.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
370.text: "If that was a guess, it was a good one. We'll make a civilized king out of you yet."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "I honestly don't give a damn. Tea is for weaklings."

373.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
373.text: "Says the king who can't end a war without Mummy's help."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "The next cup we drink together will be in Pales."

378.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
378.text: "Hmph. The next time we meet, it had better be in Pales."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "Thank you once more for your assistance, Your Excellency. I will make it up to you one day."

386.speaker: Narrator
386.text: We switched to small talk about our kingdoms as we finished our tea and sweets.

390.speaker: Narrator
390.text: We continued talking about the ceasefire arrangements as we finished our tea and sweets.

391.speaker: Narrator
391.text: The Pales war was finally going to end.

392.speaker: Narrator
392.text: But I wondered if Rizia would ever be the same.

393.speaker: Narrator
393.text: I thought once more about the offer I'd turned down.

394.speaker: Narrator
394.text: I knew more lives would be lost because of my decision. But in the long run, it would be worth it.

395.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
395.text: "Next time I'll have to invite the Duke of Pales here. Now that GRACE has accepted his application, he's one of us."
395.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true)

402.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
402.text: "Of course, as you're soon to be the king of both Pales and Rizia, I suppose I can tell you anything I'd say to him."

403.speaker: Player_Romus
403.text: "Thank you once more for accepting Pales' application. They will truly be a worthy addition to our ranks."

404.speaker: Player_Romus
404.text: "It's high time you spoke to the Duke. You two would get along fabulously."

405.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
405.text: "As long as he takes care of our Vina."

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "As the kingdom responsible for bringing the Palesians into the fold, I must insist you not make deals with them without my involvement."

410.speaker: Player_Romus
410.text: "I own the rights to the Aureus gas field. Any contribution Pales can make is only incidental."

414.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
414.text: "I'll be the judge of that. But we're off to a promising start."

415.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
415.text: "A larger monarchical presence in South Merkopa is beneficial to us all. Not to mention that gas field."

416.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
416.text: "Yes, don't worry. Rizia will always be my kingdom's oldest and dearest ally."

417.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
417.text: "I haven't forgotten about Rumburg's wedding gift, by the way."

421.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
421.text: "You tried to form a regional alliance behind Rumburg's back. You cannot come crawling back to us just because it failed."
421.conditionsRaw: (((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == true)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Budget_Modifier_ANSanctions"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Budget_Modifier_GRACETradeSurplus"] <= 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true) == false)

425.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
425.text: "And for what? A sad, failed attempt at a regional alliance?"

432.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
432.text: "It is finally ready. Would you like to see it?"

433.speaker: Narrator
433.text: Without waiting for an answer, she gestured to her attendants. One of them brought forth an oversized velvet-covered jewel case.

434.speaker: Narrator
434.text: I lifted the lid. Inside was an ornate ovoid creation, encrusted in the finest jewels.

441.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
441.text: "A genuine Hattersley egg. One of only eight in existence -- but I'm sure you knew that."

442.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
442.text: "It is a genuine Hattersley egg. One of only eight in existence -- but I'm sure you knew that."

443.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
443.text: "Symbolic of the new life my niece and her husband will bring to the Rizian throne -- and the heirs they will produce, of course."

447.speaker: Player_Romus
447.text: "Message received. The rulers of Rizia will carry the Rumburgian bloodline forth through future generations."

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "Do not put too much pressure on your niece to procreate. She's only 25."

449.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
449.text: "And if it were up to you, you'd wait until she was 30? Her womb will turn to dust."

450.speaker: Narrator
450.text: I detected a look of warning in her eyes.

451.speaker: Player_Romus
451.text: "Thank you. My house will treasure it always."

457.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
457.text: "Of course, the way things are going in Rizia at the moment, there may not be a throne for her heirs to sit on."

458.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
458.text: "I would have invited Her Highness for tea as well, but... you know."

463.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
463.text: "Still struggling with your tea etiquette, I see."

464.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
464.text: "You remembered your tea etiquette. Very nice."

469.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
469.text: "In all seriousness, Your Majesty... I and the rest of GRACE have been observing the situation in Rizia with some worry."
469.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn09_Rumburg_ServedJam"] == false) == false)

473.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
473.text: "I will assume you've appropriately punished your Golden Guard for their oversight. I can only hope she is safe and sound."

474.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
474.text: "I wanted to invite Her Highness as well, but I didn't want to interrupt her married bliss. That first year is so special."
474.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true)

475.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
475.text: "I wanted to invite Her Highness as well, but she seems to be quite the career woman these days."
475.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_DeclareIntention_Public"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_DastnuristCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Religious_WruhecsGuardians_Sal"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Unfriendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Rumburg_Hostile"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Escapes"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Engaged"] == true) == false)

479.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
479.text: "Of course, the way things are going in Rizia at the moment, perhaps she's better off abroad."

480.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
480.text: "If she ever returns, I would urge you to go easier on her. She is your only child, after all..."

484.speaker: Narrator
484.text: I thought I detected a look of warning in her eyes.

491.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
491.text: "I must tell you that I and the rest of GRACE have been slightly concerned about the direction in which Rizia is heading."

858.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
858.text: "Now. How is that war of yours going?"

879.speaker: Player_Romus
879.text: "Come on, Bea. If you don't think Romus Toras is enthusiastic about cuckolding, then you don't know me at all."

880.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
880.text: "For Dast's sake, can you be serious for five seconds? We're talking about the future of your kingdom!"

884.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
884.text: "Consider the repair of your energy grid a parting gift. Rizia will have to clean up its own messes from now on."

888.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
888.text: "In fact, the assistance we gave you for your sabotage mess might be the last aid you get from Rumburg for a while."

892.speaker: Player_Romus
892.text: "After the help you gave us fixing our damaged energy grid... I would not ask any more of you."

893.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
893.text: "I am not only offering for your sake."

897.speaker: Player_Romus
897.text: "First you help us fix our energy grid, now this? Rumburg is too kind."

898.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
898.text: "It's but a trifle. Well, no, I shouldn't speak so modestly."

902.speaker: Player_Romus
902.text: "Reaching out to our neighbors was an experiment, not a threat. I fully intended to keep my partnership with my fellow monarchies intact."

910.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
910.text: "I urge you to act in moderation. Especially where your kingdom's religious differences are concerned."

911.speaker: Player_Romus
911.text: "There's nothing I can do about it. This is the path that God has chosen for us."

912.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
912.text: "See, it's that sort of language that worries me."

913.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
913.text: "Your Majesty, the rest of the world already holds certain stereotypes about monarchs. Your religious zealotry is confirming their deepest fears."

914.speaker: Player_Romus
914.text: "I am a simple man of faith, not a zealot."

916.speaker: Player_Romus
916.text: "Stereotype or not, I'm the one God chose to rule Rizia."

917.speaker: Player_Romus
917.text: "Rizia was on the verge of being torn asunder. In faith, the kingdom will finally find unity."

918.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
918.text: "Is it 'unity' to promote only one branch of the Nurist faith, and shut out all others?"

919.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
919.text: "Come on, Romus. Drop the preacher act for one minute."

920.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
920.text: "This is what I mean. Your continued disrespect for those of different faiths has gotten out of hand."

921.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
921.text: "You are a king. One who has done his best to promote one sole faith to the detriment of all others."

922.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
922.text: "I cannot believe you would go so far as to ban Dastnurist worship in your realm. Rumburg will not accept this."

926.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
926.text: "Your so-called 'Wruhec's Guardians' are a mere pretense to threaten and oppress the Dastnurists of your realm. Rumburg cannot accept this."

927.speaker: Player_Romus
927.text: "Then I think it's about time we went our separate ways."

928.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
928.text: "I'm glad you agree. Rizia's mania is ruining GRACE's reputation."

929.speaker: Player_Romus
929.text: "Your own sister came to believe that Wruhec was right in the end. You will as well."

930.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
930.text: "Ha. She may have converted on the surface, but I'm certain my Lena never succumbed to your sham of a faith."

931.speaker: Player_Romus
931.text: "You are the intolerant one if you do not believe my Wruhecist kingdom and your Dastnurist one can exist side by side."

932.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
932.text: "We can coexist. But we cannot be partners. You have destroyed any bond we had."

933.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
933.text: "But never mind that. My point is that Rizia's mania is ruining GRACE's reputation."

934.speaker: Player_Romus
934.text: "We have an economic partnership. Religion doesn't have to factor into it."

935.speaker: Beatrice Livingston (R)
935.text: "It does when your intolerance sends Dastnurist refugees running towards our borders."
